image_description: The image displays a close-up, angled view of a split ergonomic keyboard. The focus is on the central bridge area where the two halves of the keyboard meet. A large, elongated white plastic component spans the gap between the left and right key clusters. This component appears to be a palm rest or a specialized central module rather than a traditional single-piece space bar, as it lacks the typical keycap texture and switch mechanism visibility. The keys on either side are black with white legends, set into silver/beige chassis housing.
